analysis.headline: USD/KRW rebounds to 1,345 on election follow-through capped by exporter sales
analysis.summary: USD/KRW rebounded to around 1,345 (ECB ref 1,344.69) as post-election positioning and firm U.S. Treasury yields revived dollar demand. While broader dollar momentum provided upward pressure, active corporate foreign exchange selling by semiconductor and tech exporters heavily capped the ceiling, keeping the cross contained in a 1,340–1,349 KRW range.

analysis.headline: EUR/KRW rises to 1,509 as euro cross-demand buffers dollar rebound
analysis.summary: EUR/KRW advanced to around 1,509 (ECB ref 1,509.28) as EUR/USD defended the 1.1220 mark against a broad U.S. dollar rebound. While persistent Eurozone manufacturing headwinds capped sharper gains, resilient cross-currency euro demand and KRW movement supported the pair solidly within a 1,505–1,514 KRW band.

analysis.headline: JPY/KRW steadies near 848.6 KRW per 100 JPY on intervention vigilance
analysis.summary: JPY/KRW hovered near 8.49 KRW per 1 JPY (~848.6 KRW per 100 JPY, ECB ref 8.486). Even as the BOJ reaffirmed its rate hike path, USD/JPY consolidated around 158.0, keeping the yen pressured. However, strict verbal warnings against excessive speculation from Japanese finance authorities established solid support within an 845–852 KRW range.

analysis.headline: GBP/KRW surges to 1,810 after Bank of England delivers 25bp rate hike
analysis.summary: GBP/KRW strengthened sharply toward 1,810 (ECB ref 1,809.84) after the Bank of England surprised markets with a 25 basis point hike to 4.0% in an 8-1 vote to curb inflation. Hawkish monetary policy divergence and firm cross-demand against major currencies propelled sterling higher within an active 1,805–1,816 KRW trading corridor.

analysis.headline: CNY/KRW holds near 201.7 on PBOC liquidity and NPC stimulus hopes
analysis.summary: CNY/KRW traded steadily around 201.7 (ECB ref 201.65) within a 201–203 band. The People's Bank of China maintained accommodative short-term liquidity injections alongside stable daily benchmark fixings, while anticipation of additional fiscal stimulus from the NPC Standing Committee anchored yuan sentiment. In tandem with USD/KRW rebounding, the cross consolidated orderly within a 201.0–202.5 KRW range.

AUD.headline: Australian dollar resilient near 941 KRW on hawkish RBA and commodities
AUD.brief: The Australian dollar held firm near 941 KRW, underpinned by the Reserve Bank of Australia's restrictive stance, steady commodity prices, and stimulus expectations from China.

CAD.headline: Canadian dollar defends 963 KRW with crude support cushioning BoC cuts
CAD.brief: The Canadian dollar held near 963 KRW as resilient crude oil prices and robust resource exports counterbalanced widening yield gaps from Bank of Canada rate cuts.

CHF.headline: Swiss franc climbs to 1,644 KRW on persistent safe-haven and hedge flows
CHF.brief: The Swiss franc advanced to 1,644 KRW as geopolitical vigilance and post-election hedging prompted steady safe-haven flows, outweighing the SNB's low policy rate.

CNY.headline: Chinese yuan anchors near 201.7 KRW on PBOC liquidity and NPC stimulus hopes
CNY.brief: The Chinese yuan traded steadily near 201.7 KRW, anchored by ample PBOC liquidity support, firm central fixings, and high anticipation for the NPC stimulus package.

EUR.headline: Euro advances to 1,509 KRW supported by EUR/USD resilience and cross demand
EUR.brief: The euro rose to 1,509 KRW as EUR/USD defended 1.1220 and cross-currency buying offset ongoing sluggishness in Eurozone manufacturing indicators.

GBP.headline: British pound jumps to 1,810 KRW following BoE 25bp interest rate hike
GBP.brief: Sterling surged to 1,810 KRW after the Bank of England raised its Bank Rate by 25 bps to 4.0% to combat persistent inflation and Middle East energy pressures.

HKD.headline: Hong Kong dollar tracks USD rebound within peg band near 171.4 KRW
HKD.brief: The Hong Kong dollar tracked the U.S. dollar's recovery within the 7.75–7.85 peg band, steadying near 171.4 KRW amid active cross-border capital flows in Asian markets.

JPY.headline: Japanese yen defends 848.6 KRW per 100 JPY amid intervention alertness
JPY.brief: The yen held near 848.6 KRW per 100 JPY as firm intervention warnings from Tokyo authorities cushioned pressure stemming from USD/JPY hovering near 158.0.

KRW.headline: Korean won defends 1,345 KRW anchored by chip export surplus and 3.00% rate
KRW.brief: The won absorbed dollar rebound pressure, supported by sustained semiconductor export trade surpluses and the Bank of Korea's 3.00% base rate buffer.

USD.headline: U.S. dollar rebounds to 1,345 KRW on election momentum capped by exporter sales
USD.brief: The U.S. dollar rebounded toward 1,345 KRW on higher Treasury yields and election follow-through, while active domestic exporter selling limited gains.
